resolved_findings.finding: An interrupt raised by process.wait could leave the child running while the launcher closed its console and returned.
resolved_findings.resolution: wait_for_child catches KeyboardInterrupt, records it and repeats waiting on the same child handle. It never relaunches.
resolved_findings.verification: Source lines92-99 plus fake first-wait KeyboardInterrupt then successful second-wait case; both ordinary and optimized Python reports PASS36.
